name: Letting Go
overview: Scripture calls believers to relinquish reliance on their own understanding and to trust wholly in the LORD, focusing their hearts and eyes steadfastly on Him rather than dwelling on past hurts or former things. Letting go involves embracing God's truth, which brings freedom, and exercising wisdom by restraining impulsive expressions of pain. God's plans for His people are rooted in peace and hope, encouraging believers to release old burdens and look forward to the future He has prepared.
